messages.home-browser-body: Your games are read by the desktop program.
messages.home-failed-title: Your list of games couldn't be read.
messages.home-no-list-body: List your games and their folders in .local/games.json, in this program's folder. config/games.example.json shows how.
messages.home-never-body: None of this game's repositories has any commits to show.
messages.unfinished-files:
{ $count ->
    [one] One file
   *[other] { $count } files
  } changed but not committed
messages.pending-earlier:
{ $count ->
    [one] and one earlier draft
   *[other] and { $count } earlier drafts
  }
messages.pending-unreleased:
{ $count ->
    [one] One entry waiting for a version
   *[other] { $count } entries waiting for a version
  }
messages.open-count:
{ $count ->
    [one] One item still open
   *[other] { $count } items still open
  }
messages.repo-problem-missing: That folder isn't there. Check its name in .local/games.json.
messages.repo-problem-not-a-repository: That folder has no history to read. Check its name in .local/games.json.
messages.repo-problem-git-missing: Git could not be started. Install Git and look again.
messages.repo-problem-git-failed: Git stopped with an error. Look again, or run git status in that folder to see why.
messages.source-body: Each date and message is read from that repository's own history, its changelogs and its open-work list. This page only reads; it never changes a repository or a game.
messages.legend-observed: Read from a file or a repository
messages.legend-worked: Worked out from what was read
messages.tools-source: Read from the tool kit's own list of commands.
messages.tools-browser: This is the browser preview, so the tools can't be reached. The desktop program reads them.
messages.reports-title: What do you want to know about { $game }?
messages.reports-browser: Reports run in the desktop program.
messages.reports-empty: No reports for { $game } yet. They appear here once the tools can read this game.
messages.reports-running-note: The first run can take a little while.
messages.failure-refused: This program doesn't run that report.
messages.failure-refused-next: It only runs reports that read and need nothing typed. Choose one from the list.
messages.failure-python-missing-next: Install Python 3.10 or newer, or set PHOBOS_COMPANION_PYTHON to the one you use, then try again.
messages.failure-kit-missing: The tool kit is not where this program expects it.
messages.failure-kit-missing-next: Run git submodule update --init in this program's folder, or set PHOBOS_COMPANION_KIT, then try again.
messages.failure-tool-failed: The tool kit started but stopped with an error.
messages.failure-tool-failed-next: Open the technical details below, and run the same command in a console to see more.
messages.failure-unreadable: The tool kit answered in a way this program doesn't understand.
messages.failure-unreadable-next: This program and its tool kit may not match. Run git submodule update in this program's folder.
messages.failure-list-unreadable: Your list of games has a mistake in it.
messages.failure-list-unreadable-next: Open .local/games.json in this program's folder and compare it with config/games.example.json. The technical details below name the problem.
messages.status-reading-only: Reading only: nothing here can change a game, a save or a repository.
